title: I gave Opus 5.5 one prompt and six hours to visualize Invisible Cities
summary: A creative experiment using Claude Opus 5.5 AI model with a single prompt over six hours to automatically generate visualizations of Italo Calvino's literary masterpiece 'Invisible Cities', demonstrating the capabilities of modern AI in artistic interpretation and image generation.
problem_solved: Demonstrates how AI can interpret complex literary descriptions and convert them into visual representations with minimal human intervention.
why_valuable: Shows the artistic potential of AI models for creative tasks and bridges literature with visual art through automated interpretation.
